call.hello.hello_again.back: Hello, can you still hear me?

call.speech.im_here.back: Yes, I'm here, I can hear you. I'm listening to you.

call.speech.still_there.back: Hello? Are you still on the line?

call.speech.no_thanks.back: No, thank you, I don't need it.

call.speech.think_about_it.back: I have to think about it.

call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Wait, please, I have one more question.

call.speech.no_wait.back: "one moment", "one second", "wait a little", "wait", "I'll check right away", "let me check"

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number called is not available at the moment. Come back later.

call.speech.preview.back: Hello? / Ah, a package? Sure, leave it at the door, thank you very much. / Fine, goodbye.

call.speech.closing.back: Farewells: goodbye, until we hear again, have a good day, have a good evening, bye, bye-bye, we'll hear each other, we'll talk more, all the best, only good (all the best), see you soon. Wrap-ups: fine, then that's how it stays; I won't keep you any longer; I have to hang up; we'll talk later. Ends: Thank you for the information, goodbye. / I noted all the details, have a good day. / Fine, I'm running to the meeting, bye. / I'm getting behind the wheel now, we'll hear each other. Not ends: The courier left without saying goodbye, can you help me with the receipt? / How good that we hear each other clearly now, tell me the details. / About the new technician I heard only good things, when can he come? / I hope we solve the situation soon, which form needs to be filled in?
call.speech.closing.note: verified=false: neverificat automat; farewells din ciorna Gemini, alese manual. | Farewells all genuine; no_wait unaffected. Example not_ends #2 uses informal "spune-mi" among otherwise formal lines and #4 uses "pe curând" as plain "soon"; examples are not machine-verified, accepted.

notify.h_urgent_transfer.note: Eticheta „De făcut” trebuie să fie identică cu notify.s_todo.

console.setup_title.back: Welcome! Three steps and the phone answers by itself

console.g_basics_d.back: A few things the AI needs before it can answer the phone.

console.f_language_h.back: The language in which the AI speaks with callers.

console.f_notify_lang_h.back: The language of the notifications and summaries you read. It does not change the language in which the AI speaks with callers.

console.nl_same.back: The same as the AI's language

console.f_simlang_h.back: Only for a phone with a SIM from another country: calls on that SIM start in the language chosen here. Requires app 1.0 or newer.

console.sl_empty.back: Nothing set: every call starts in the language above.

console.f_owner_h.back: The name callers use for you. The AI uses it when it talks about you.

console.f_owner_aliases.back: Other names callers use for you

console.f_owner_aliases_h.back: A nickname, another first name, etc. One per line, at most 10. The AI will know they refer to you.

console.style_assistant_d.back: Says it is your AI assistant and takes a message.

console.style_persona_d.back: Answers as if you were you, without accepting anything on your behalf.

console.f_key_link.back: Get a key from Google AI Studio

console.f_model_h.back: The model the AI speaks with. It rarely needs changing.

console.f_voice_h.back: The preview plays three example lines in the language chosen above.

console.f_enabled_h.back: Off: calls are picked up and closed immediately. For the phone to ring normally, use “Switch to ordinary phone” from the System page or from the app.

console.f_ring_h.back: Lets the phone ring a little before it answers, like a person. 0 = immediately.

console.f_normal_max.back: Max. duration of a normal call

console.f_normal_max_h.back: Between 3 and 30. Shortly before the limit, the AI politely wraps up the conversation and hangs up.

console.f_prewarm.back: Get the AI ready while the phone rings

console.f_prewarm_h.back: Recommended: the AI speaks as soon as it answers. Off: callers wait 1–3 seconds.

console.f_unknown_h.back: On: callers with no number shown talk to the AI like anyone else. Off: they hear a short unavailability announcement and the call ends.

console.f_barge_h.back: The AI stops and listens when the caller talks over it. Not all phones can do this; Bageo checks by itself.

console.f_vad.back: Let Gemini decide when the caller has finished speaking

console.f_vad_h.back: Recommended. Off: it is decided only by the volume of the voice.

console.f_reply_lang_h.back: When the caller speaks another language, the AI switches to that language.

console.f_status_h.back: A note about your current situation, such as where a courier should leave a parcel. The AI mentions it only when it fits the call.

console.f_status_ph.back: e.g. Deliveries: please leave the parcel at reception.

console.f_amb_h.back: Adds a discreet ambience behind the AI's voice so it sounds like a real person.

console.g_spam_d.back: What the AI does when the caller is clearly trying to sell something or to deceive.

console.f_stall_h.back: The AI seems interested and asks for details to waste their time. It reveals nothing and accepts nothing. Off: it refuses and hangs up.

console.f_stall_max_h.back: Between 3 and 30. Longer calls consume more of your Gemini quota.

console.f_stall_model_h.back: Empty = the same model as for ordinary calls.

console.g_prompt_d.back: A few short answers help the AI sound like you. All are optional.

console.f_prompt.note: fixed: same name as instrucțiuni elsewhere

console.f_prompt_ph.back: Empty: the built-in instructions are used

console.f_prompt_h.back: If you fill it in, it replaces the speaking style and local habits. Each answer style keeps its own text; write {owner} for your name.

console.p_builtin_h.back: For the saved language, answer style and name. Save first if you have just changed them.

console.p_clear.back: Go back to the built-in one (clear)

console.p_replace_body.back: The editor already has text. It will be replaced with the built-in instructions.

console.f_knowledge.back: Information the AI can answer from

console.f_knowledge_ph.back:
e.g. Parcels: leave them at reception.
Opening hours: Monday–Friday, 9–18.

console.f_knowledge_h.back: Things callers may ask about, one per line. The AI is not allowed to invent anything that is not written here.

console.g_blocked_d.back: Played when a call from the blacklist or from a hidden number is rejected. Manage the blacklist under “Contacts”.

console.b_help.back: End a number with * to put on the blacklist all numbers that start the same way, e.g. 0800* (at least 3 digits, excluding leading zeros).

console.reject_decline.back: Hang up while it rings (the call does not connect)

console.reject_announce.back: Answer, play the unavailability announcement, then hang up

console.f_reject_voice_h.back: The announcement is spoken in the language chosen above.

console.rv_same.back: The same as the AI's voice

console.g_notify_d.back: Receive a message when a call comes in and the summary when it ends.

console.f_notify_on_h.back: Off: nothing is sent on any notification channel.

console.n_empty.back: No notification channels yet. Add one to receive call summaries on your phone.

console.n_ctl_h.back: Check calls, give the AI an errand and handle “To do” directly from this chat. Send /help for the commands.

console.n_ctl_users_h.back: In a group, write who can give commands, otherwise nobody can. In a private chat you can leave it empty. Your ID: ask @userinfobot.

console.rc_desc.back: First turn on “Receive commands from this chat” for a notification channel above.

console.rc_env.back: Receive commands in the Telegram chat set through environment variables

console.rc_env_h.back: The bot and chat from TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. TELEGRAM_CONTROL_USERS limits who can give commands.

console.rc_errands.back: AI errands per chat per hour

console.rc_errands_h.back: 0 = no AI calls from chat. At most 30.

console.rc_msgs_h.back: Above this limit, that chat gets no more answers for the rest of the minute.

console.mcp_title.back: Allow other AI tools to connect (MCP)

console.mcp_desc.back: Allows AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to look at the calls and the “To do” list. Leave it off if you do not need it.

console.mcp_on_h.back: Works only when it is on and the Token below is set. The address is the web console's address plus /mcp.

console.mcp_tok_h.back: Enter this Token in the AI tool (as a Bearer token).

console.mcp_calls.back: May it ask the AI to make calls?

console.mcp_c_confirm.back: Yes, but ask me first in chat

console.mcp_calls_h.back: “Ask me first” requires a chat that receives commands.

console.mcp_errands_h.back: All AI tools together, from 0 to 30.

console.mcp_origins_h.back: Only for AI tools that run in a web page: one address per line, e.g. https://app.example. Otherwise leave empty.

console.hint_telegram.back: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token. Chat ID: @userinfobot tells you yours; for a group use the group's ID and add the bot to it. Send the bot a message once so it can write to you.

console.hint_discord.back: Notifications: fill in a Webhook URL (channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL) or the bot's token and the channel ID; one is enough. For a private message, put your own ID in the channel ID field. Chat commands: fill in the bot's token and the channel ID and turn on Message Content Intent for the bot.

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: copy an Incoming Webhook URL (also for Mattermost) or fill in the bot's token and the channel ID; one is enough. Chat commands (Slack only): turn on Socket Mode, then fill in the bot's token (xoxb-), the app-level token (xapp-) and the channel ID.

console.hint_line.back: LINE Developers console → your Messaging API channel: issue a channel access token and copy your user ID (starts with U). First add the bot as a friend. LINE Notify was shut down in 2025; this replaces it.

console.hint_ntfy.back: Choose a topic name that is hard to guess and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. Leave the server empty for ntfy.sh. A token is needed only for protected topics.

console.hint_gotify.back: In Gotify: Apps → Create application, then copy the token. The server URL is the address of your Gotify server.

console.hint_bark.back: Open the Bark app on the iPhone and copy the device key from the example URL. Leave the server empty to use the public one.

console.hint_pushover.back: Create an application on pushover.net to get the API token. Your user key is on the Pushover dashboard.

console.hint_wecom.back: In the WeCom group: add a group bot, then copy the webhook URL.

console.hint_dingtalk.back: Group settings → Bots → add a custom bot and copy the webhook URL. If you chose “Sign” for security, paste the secret key (starts with SEC).

console.hint_feishu.back: Group settings → Bots → Add bot → Custom bot, then copy the webhook URL. Do not turn on signature verification.

console.hint_serverchan.back: Copy the SendKey from the ServerChan site.

console.hint_matrix.back: Your server (homeserver, e.g. https://matrix.org), an access token of the sending account and the ID of a room the account has joined (starts with !).

console.hint_gmail.back: Your Gmail address and an app password (Google Account → Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords). Not your usual password.

console.hint_apprise.back: The notification URL of your Apprise API server, e.g. http://host:8000/notify/KEY. A tag limits which services receive the message.

console.hint_webhook.back: Any URL that accepts a JSON POST with event, title, body and data. Useful for n8n, Home Assistant or your own scripts.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: the channel's … menu → Workflows → “Post to a channel when a webhook request is received”, follow the steps and copy the URL you get. The old Office 365 connectors have been retired.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open the space → Apps and integrations → Webhooks → Add webhook, then copy the URL. Requires a Google Workspace account.

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration → Workspace → Integrations → New → Incoming: turn it on, choose the channel and copy the webhook URL.

console.hint_zulip.back: Personal settings → Bots → Add a new bot (Incoming webhook or Generic) and enter the email and API key as email:key. Destination: stream > topic (e.g. calls > phone) or one or more emails for a direct message.

console.hint_webex.back: Create a bot on developer.webex.com and copy the access token. Add the bot to a space and enter the room ID, or a person's email.

console.hint_nextcloud.back: Your Nextcloud address, your user name and an app password (Settings → Security) written as user:password, plus the conversation token: the last part of the conversation's link.

console.hint_synology.back: In Synology Chat: Integration → Incoming Webhooks → Create, then copy the webhook URL. On your own network, the http:// address on port 5000 avoids certificate errors.

console.hint_signal.back: Requires your own signal-cli-rest-api server with a registered number. Enter the server address, the registered number in international format (+…) and the recipients: numbers or group IDs, separated by commas.

console.hint_pushbullet.back: pushbullet.com → Settings → Account → Create Access Token. Leave the target empty to send to all your devices, or enter a device ID or an email.

console.hint_pushplus.back: Log in on pushplus.plus and copy the token. A group code sends to that group; empty sends only to you.

console.hint_pushdeer.back: Open the PushDeer app, add a key and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public one.

console.hint_wxpusher.back: Simplest: a simple push token (SPT_…) from the WxPusher site, with no target. Or the app's appToken (AT_…) with user IDs (UID_…) or topic IDs, separated by commas.

console.hint_chanify.back: In the Chanify app, create a token for this sender and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public one.

console.hint_smtp.back: Any email server with TLS: smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://…:465. The login account is also the sender. Use an app password if your provider offers one.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: Your Home Assistant address, a long-lived access token (Profile → Security) and the notification service, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (shown in Developer tools → Actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: ifttt.com/maker_webhooks → Documentation shows you the key. Create an applet “If Webhooks: Receive a web request” with the same event name; value1 is the title and value2 the message.

console.f_public_url_h.back: The links in notifications use this address. Empty = the one shown in grey; with Docker or for access from outside the home, write your own address.

console.g_summary_d.back: After each call, the AI writes a short summary. Usually nothing needs to be configured here.

console.f_sum_base_h.back: Any OpenAI-compatible service works, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.

console.f_sum_provider_h.back: By default it uses your Gemini key. For another service, choose “Another service”.

console.f_cal_suggest_h.back: When a date is set in a call (a delivery, an appointment), the summary includes an “Add to calendar” link.

console.f_appt_mode_h.back: When a caller wants to set a time, the AI does not accept on the spot; it says it will check and get back. Then you press Accept or Decline under “To do” on the Calls page or in the notification.

console.f_appt_sms.back: Send an SMS to the caller

console.f_appt_sms_h.back: After you decide, the phone that took the call sends an SMS to the caller (mobile numbers only). Off: the AI calls them back.

console.f_appt_reply_h.back: Automatic: SMS to a mobile, AI call back to a landline. Hidden numbers and those that cannot be called back (international, toll-free, etc.) get no reply.

console.f_think_h.back: Only for models with “thinking” in the name. “Low” answers fastest.

console.ph_none.back: Connect the phone with a USB data cable, turn on USB debugging and open the app.

console.ph_unauth.back: Waiting for permission: unlock the phone and accept the “Allow USB debugging?” window.

console.ph_offline.back: Disconnected: unplug the cable and connect it again.

console.ph_noapp.back: The Bageo app is not installed on this phone.

console.ph_link_ok.back: The USB link is active and the app is installed

console.ph_link_bad.back: The USB link is not ready yet. Wait a few seconds.

console.usb_off_d.back: Phones connect to Bageo over the network.

console.usb_noadb_d.back: Phones on USB cannot be set up automatically. Install Android platform-tools or set ADB_BIN.

console.chk_key_bad.back: Add the key so the AI can talk.

console.chk_owner_bad.back: Tell the AI what callers call you.

console.chk_prompt_bad.back: Answer a few questions under “About you” so the AI sounds more like you.

console.chk_phone_bad.back: No phone connected now. See “Phones” on this page.

console.chk_notify_bad.back: Add a notification channel to receive call summaries on your phone.

console.chk_summary_bad.back: Needs a Gemini key or another summary service.

console.chk_all.back: Everything is ready. Call your phone's number to try it.

console.a2hs_title.back: Add this page to the home screen. Next time, just tap the icon.

console.a2hs_android.back: Android: Chrome menu ⋮ → Add to Home screen.

console.a2hs_desktop.back: Computer: the install icon on the right of the address bar (Chrome, Edge).

console.ph_need_update.back: Update the Bageo app on this phone to switch it from here

console.pm_err_failed.back: an error occurred on the phone

console.er_new_d.back: The AI calls, sorts it out and tells you how it went. During the call you can read the live transcript and tell the AI at any time what to do.

console.er_to_ph.back: Type a name to find a contact or a phone number

console.er_no_match.back: No contact with this name. You can also type the number directly.

console.er_task.back: What needs to be sorted out

console.er_task_ph.back:
e.g. Book a table for 4 people tomorrow at 19:00 under Popescu, non-smoking; if 19:00 is full, between 19:30 and 20:00 also works
or: Ask him which day of the weekend, Saturday or Sunday, suits him for dinner

console.er_task_h.back: Write what you want it to sort out and what conditions you can accept. If the AI is unsure during the call, it asks you here.

console.er_id_assistant_d.back: The AI says it is calling on your behalf, as an assistant.

console.er_id_owner_d.back: The AI speaks on your behalf.

console.er_phone_auto.back: Automatic (a free line that can call this number)

console.er_phone_normal.back: {name} (ordinary phone mode, the AI cannot use it)

console.er_pre_d.back: Add them so the AI does not have to stop and ask you during the call.

console.er_started.back: Handed over to the AI. It is calling now.

console.er_queued.back: Waiting. The AI calls as soon as a phone becomes free.

console.er_empty_body.back: Write above what needs sorting out. The AI calls, takes care of it and tells you the result.

console.er_redial_h.back: If nobody answers or the line is busy, it calls again every minute, at most 30 times.

console.er_live_wait.back: The number is being dialed, waiting for an answer…

console.er_watching.back: You are following the call: when it is not sure, the AI asks you first.

console.er_q_over.back: Time has expired, the AI will decide

console.er_tell_ph.back: e.g. Tell him it also works at 20:00

console.er_hangup_b.back: The AI ends the call immediately. The errand may not be finished.

console.er_unconfirmed.back: Not confirmed by the other side

console.er_ans_absent.back: You were not here, no answer

console.er_err_bad_number.back: This number does not look right.

console.er_err_not_allowed.back: The AI cannot call this number (emergency, special or premium-rate number).

console.er_err_no_sim_for_country.back: No phone has a SIM card that can call numbers from this country.

console.er_err_sim_unknown.back: This phone has not yet taken any call, so the system does not know which SIM cards it has. Call it once, then try again.

console.er_err_no_task.back: Write what the AI should sort out.

console.er_err_task_too_long.back: The text is too long: at most 1,000 characters.

console.er_err_no_phone.back: No AI phone is available now (none connected, or all are in ordinary phone mode).

console.er_err_not_found.back: This AI errand or this contact no longer exists.

console.er_err_busy.back: This call is still waiting or in progress. Try after it ends.

console.er_err_not_on_call.back: The call has ended, so the AI can no longer pass this on.

console.f_er_identity_h.back: Who the AI says it is when it calls for you. You can also choose separately for each errand.

console.ct_kind_whitelist.back: Whitelist (family and friends; they can be transferred to you)

console.ct_kind_stall.back: List for stalling (the AI wastes their time from the start)

console.ct_kind_help.back: How calls from this number are handled.

console.wl_desc.back: Choose who can reach you and when. This does not replace emergency services.

console.wl_m_direct.back: Do not answer: send to your phone

console.wl_m_emergency.back: The AI answers and connects you if it is urgent

console.f_wl_num_h.back: The number the phone calls when something is urgent.

console.f_ui_pw_h.back: Once set, the web console asks for it on opening (once per browser). Needed to open the web console on a phone or another computer.

console.pw_setup_title.back: Set a password for the web console (optional)

console.pw_setup_body.back: Set a password if you will open this web console from outside the home network. You can change it later in Settings.

console.pw_setup_help.back: This browser remembers it. You will be asked again on a new device.

console.pw_setup_short.back: The password must have at least 8 characters.

console.g_region_d.back: Most people do not need these.

console.n_ctl_users_h_discord.back: In a server channel, write who can give commands, otherwise nobody can. In a private message you can leave it empty. Your ID: turn on Developer Mode, then right-click your name → Copy User ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_slack.back: In a channel, write who can give commands, otherwise nobody can. In a direct message you can leave it empty. Your member ID: open your profile → ⋮ → Copy member ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_matrix.back: In a room with other people, write who can give commands, otherwise nobody can. A room with only you and the bot can stay empty. A Matrix ID looks like @name:matrix.org.

console.n_ctl_h_slack.back: Check calls, give the AI an errand and handle “To do” directly from this chat. Send “@your bot /help” for the commands.

console.n_ctl_h_matrix.back: Check calls, give the AI an errand and handle “To do” directly from this chat. Send “@your bot /help” for the commands.

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_failed.back: Urgent: you could not be reached

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_ai_ende.back: Urgent: the AI left the call while calling you

console.urg_why_phone.back: the phone could not make the call

console.er_err_empty_text.back: Write what you want to say.

console.er_err_text_too_long.back: The text is too long. Shorten it.

console.er_err_question_closed.back: This question has already been answered or has expired.

console.err_device_in_call.back: Wait for the call on this phone to end.

console.sms_empty_d.back: The SMS messages the phones receive appear here once SMS forwarding is active.
